title: Inflated Excellence or True Performance? Rethinking Medical Diagnostic Benchmarks with Dynamic Evaluation

bias_targets.methodology: Introducing diagnostic distractors or 'traps' (such as patient self-diagnosis, distracting medical history, and external noise) into patient queries to simulate anchor bias, confirmation bias, over-interpretation bias, and background noise bias, and subsequently measuring the drop in the LLM's diagnostic accuracy.

Conducting a self-recognition experiment by comparing an LLM's diagnostic accuracy on datasets generated by itself versus datasets generated by other LLMs to check if the model unfairly favors or performs better on its own generated text.
